2757-3800-4687.notablePrerequisites: Iceberg has at least three counters on it.
2757-3800-4687.description:
Activate a basic Forest or Island by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Gilder Bairn, untapping the basic Forest or Island.
Activate the Forest or Island by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Iceberg.
Activate Iceberg as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Iceberg, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

5627-7705-7857.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
5627-7705-7857.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Mole Man and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Repeat.

2092-2757-2851-5140.description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Death Cultist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Death Cultist, untapping the basic Swamp.
Activate Death Cultist by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

430-2743-5184-6222.easyPrerequisites: You haven't created any tokens this turn.
430-2743-5184-6222.description:
Declare Emissary Green as an attacker, triggering its ability. Choose to vote for "Profit", creating at least three token copies of Biovisionary due to Esix and Xorn.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

141-5147-7449.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 4 or less.
141-5147-7449.description:
Cast Stir the Grave by paying {4}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Stir the Grave.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Stir the Grave
Resolve the Stir the Grave copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1978-3007-7434--148.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1978-3007-7434--148.notablePrerequisites:
There are legal targets for the spell with {X} in its mana cost, if applicable.
You have enough mana to cast the spell with {X} in its mana cost reduced by {C}{C}, accounting for {X} to be 2 or greater if you wish to gain life.
1978-3007-7434--148.description:
Animate Brass Infiniscope.
Activate Brass Infiniscope by tapping it, adding {C}{C} and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Brass Infiniscope.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 as desired.
Cast the spell with {X} in its mana cost, with {X} being at least 2 if you wish to gain life.
Each instance of Brass Infiniscope's delayed triggered ability triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain half X life, rounded down, for each trigger.
1978-3007-7434--148.notes: Each activation of Brass Infiniscope adds a delayed triggered ability that can draw you cards and gain life if you cast a spell with {X} in its cost. If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

5231-6871-6879-7223.description:
Cast Stalactite Dagger by paying {2}.
When Stalactite Dagger enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Shapeshifter creature token with changeling.
When the Shapeshifter enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Stalactite Dagger, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Stalactite Dagger.
When Stalactite Dagger dies, Haru triggers, returning Stalactite Dagger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Repeat from step 4.

147-7063.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
147-7063.description:
Cast Ember Island Production by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Ember Island Production, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Ember Island Production, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

1978-3007-7013.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1978-3007-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
1978-3007-7013.description:
Animate White Lotus Tile using Toymaker.
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping White Lotus Tile.
Repeat from step 2.

141-780-2438.description:
Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Supernatural Stamina, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Supernatural Stamina.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Carrion Feeder abilities from step 5.

413-1336-1636-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 5 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
413-1336-1636-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
When Sin enters, Intruder Alarm and Blasting Station trigger, untapping all creatures and Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sin.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it triggers, putting its counters on Heronblade Elite.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to its power.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

3609-5090-6702.easyPrerequisites: You have a repeatable way to allow Kilo to tap.
3609-5090-6702.description:
Tap Kilo by any method.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Singing Bell Strike by paying {6}, untapping Kilo.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time. Then, repeat steps 1 and 2 one additional time.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
3609-5090-6702.notes: You can use any method(s) to tap Kilo three times per turn. If those methods have additional costs (such as life payments, mana, etc.), then you must pay those costs three times as well.

539-1129-4657.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Allies.
539-1129-4657.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Harabaz Druid.
Repeat.

1737-2829-4242-4853.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {4} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Su-Chi.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Su-Chi.
When Su-Chi dies, Su-Chi and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1750-2793-4779-5261-5740.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Assassin that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1750-2793-4779-5261-5740.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus.
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using an Assassin, triggering Layla Hassan, returning Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.

997-3951-5703-5929.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
997-3951-5703-5929.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

3129-4365-4636-5770.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating four 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers four times, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat.

1283-3657-4659-5432.manaNeeded: {1} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1283-3657-4659-5432.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents who each control at least one artifact.
1283-3657-4659-5432.description:
Cast Journey On either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1} and commander tax, if applicable, creating at least three Map artifact tokens and exiling Journey On with the ability to cast it from exile.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing three Maps, adding six {C}.
Cast Kellan from exile by paying {2}.
Activate Kogla by paying {2}, returning Kellan from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Maps, and you may use the Maps to put infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.

188-2178-4227.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
188-2178-4227.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1124-1543-2247.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two other planeswalkers.
Teferi has an amount of loyalty counters on it equal to eleven minus twice the number of other planeswalkers you control.
1124-1543-2247.description:
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing an extra activation of your planeswalkers' abilities this turn.
Activate Teferi by putting zero loyalty counters on it, putting a loyalty counter on itself.
Repeat step 2 twice for each other planeswalker you control.
Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Repeat steps 1 through 3.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat from step 1.

2067-2542-5018.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least thirty, minus one for each poison counter your opponents have and for each creature you control.
2067-2542-5018.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
Cast Sea Kings' Blessing by paying {U}, targeting every creature you control.
Venerated Rotpriest triggers for each creature targeted by Sea Kings' Blessing.
Resolve the first trigger, causing an opponent to get a poison counter.
Repeat step 4 until an opponent loses the game due to having ten poison counters, then repeat for each other opponent.

1976-3532-4928-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
1976-3532-4928-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Forgotten Ancient triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2281-3604-4050.description:
Cast Saffi by paying {G}{W}.
When Saffi enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Saffi.
Activate the Saffi token by sacrificing it, targeting the nontoken Saffi.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Saffi, adding {1}.
When the nontoken Saffi dies, the token Saffi triggers, returning the nontoken Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3297-3665-4508.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one artifact.
You have at least three opponents.
3297-3665-4508.description:
Cast Artificial Evolution by paying {U}, changing all instances of "Pirate" on Malcolm to "Minotaur" until end of turn.
Activate Penregon Strongbull by paying {1} and sacrificing an artifact, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Malcolm triggers for each opponent dealt damage this way, creating that many Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

618-2034-4242-4499.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping itself, creating a token copy of Su-Chi.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing copy of Su-Chi, adding {C}{C}.
Su-Chi triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

1588-3430-4762.notablePrerequisites: All permanents do not have summoning sickness.
1588-3430-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Ezuri's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}{G}, causing all Elves you control to get +3/+3 and trample until end of turn.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

4270-4377-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional Islands.
4270-4377-4423.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
Play Mystic Sanctuary to put Walk the Aeons on top of your library.
Activate Trade Routes' first ability by paying {1}, returning Mystic Sanctuary to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
